text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 电影场景第2批 · 01 · 白昼钢琴排练室.
Environment:  A modest Los Angeles music rehearsal studio at late morning. A worn walnut upright piano at left with closed music notebook, oak parquet, cream plaster walls, tall steel-framed windows with ivory linen curtains, a simple wooden stool and three stacked record sleeves without artwork. Rear glass door opens to a pale stucco courtyard. A small faded powder-blue acoustic panel provides restrained color. View through partly open doorway, piano side framing and clear center floor. Intimate authentic working musician space, not concert hall. No people on album covers. Natural rectangular piano keys and plausible instrument construction.
Visual medium: realistic live action; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent elevated three-quarter axonometric cutaway / dollhouse image. Remove roof and selected foreground walls to expose the connected spatial volume, floor levels, entrances, furniture and surroundings. Outdoor locations use an elevated terrain model. Clear layered depth, white presentation margin, no inset pictures.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Create one spatial reference image for 电影场景第2批 · 01 · 白昼钢琴排练室. Image1 is exact visual style and scene identity reference. Image2 is the spatial layout authority. Preserve same single location, all door/window/landmark/furniture relationships. Unseen sides may be reconstructed conservatively. One large roofless axonometric 3D dollhouse cutaway of the entire plan, coherent wall heights, all key furnishings and access visible, white page. For outdoors a raised site massing model. No people, animals, human pictures or silhouettes. No invented numbers/dimensions. Preserve original materials, palette and lighting. No added rooms or unrelated locations.
